Maya: Quick shout — huge thanks to @Ibrahim for rescuing the demo VM and restoring the dataset before the customer call. Legend move. :sparkles:
Ibrahim: No problem! Spotted the corrupted shard, reran the ingest and got it green. Happy it worked out. :white_check_mark:
Ruth: Ibrahim to the rescue! Can we put this on the kudos list for Friday? I can add a one-liner to the all-hands slide. :memo:
Maya: Please do. Also logistics question: want to drop a small thank-you on his desk? Snacks or tea? React with :cookie: for cookies, :tea: for tea, or :bagel: for bagels.
Omar: Cookies all the way. :cookie:
Ibrahim: Haha Im easy. No need but cookies would be delightful. :blush:
sys-bot: Note: automated backup completed at 2026-03-19T11:02:00Z; incident INC-493 tagged for follow-up by @Ibrahim.
Ruth: sys-bot noted. Ibrahim if you can paste the quick recovery steps here Ill add to the runbook and pin it.
Ibrahim: Will paste in channel tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone for the speedy coordination. :raised_hands:
Maya: OK cookies seem to be winning. Thanks again, truly saved the call! :trophy:
